title: Indolent and mantle B-cell lymphoma
subtitle: Follicular and mantle cell — grouped because both are managed as chronic disease with BTK inhibitors, bendamustine and maintenance, not because mantle cell is indolent. It is not: it is biologically aggressive and behaves like a disease you manage rather than cure
source: Stanford Oncology Handbook 2025, Lymphoma: Non-Hodgkin, pp.223–232 · NCCN B-Cell Lymphoma v2.2025 · items marked † are outside the handbook chapter

blocks.heading: Follicular grade
rows: >15 centroblasts/hpf, centrocytes absent, sheets of centroblasts — aggressive, behaves like DLBCL

blocks.heading: FLIPI — “NoLASH”, 1 point each
blocks.footnote: Nodal sites >4 · LDH elevated · Age ≥60 · Stage III–IV · Hgb <12. FLIPI2 instead uses age >60, β2-microglobulin > ULN, marrow involvement, Hgb <12 and largest node >6 cm — 5-yr PFS 80% / 51% / 19%.

blocks.heading: GELF — when to treat follicular
rows: Any nodal or extranodal mass ≥7 cm
Symptoms attributable to disease, including B symptoms or effusions/ascites
blocks.footnote: Meeting none of these is a reason to observe, not to treat. Brice, JCO 1997 · NCCN v2.2025.

blocks.heading: MIPI — mantle cell
blocks.footnote: Hoster, Blood 2008. The handbook prints the points table but not the risk-group cutoffs or their survival.

blocks.html: TP53 in mantle cell. Mutated in ~10% and a strong predictor of poor outcome with chemotherapy and with autologous transplant, and also with ibrutinib. Send NGS at diagnosis; prefer a clinical trial. Deep responses have been seen with targeted combinations — BOVen (zanubrutinib/obinutuzumab/venetoclax) and OAsIs.

boxes: prolongs time to next treatment, no OS benefit
after high intensity: BTKi ×2 yr + rituximab q8wk ×2–3 yr
after lower intensity: rituximab q8wk ×3 yr

blocks.html: The case for autologous transplant in mantle cell has collapsed. The old PFS benefit predates BTKi and maintenance. TRIANGLE found no benefit once ibrutinib was added, and EA4151 none for patients in MRD-negative CR.

blocks.heading: Regimens
rows: Rituximab 375 · cyclophosphamide 750 · vincristine 1.4 (max 2 mg) d1 + prednisone 40/day d1–5, with doxorubicin 50 (CHOP) or without (CVP)
375 q2 months ×2 years (PRIMA). In MCL: 375 weekly ×4 q6 mo ×2 yr, or q3 mo ×2 yr
1000 mg d1, 8, 15, then monthly C2–6/8, then bimonthly ×2 yr
Rituximab 375 d1; lenalidomide 20 mg PO d1–21 + ASA 81 mg
Prednisone 20 + cyclophosphamide 50 + etoposide 50 + procarbazine 50 mg, all PO daily until WBC <3,000, then resume on a reduced schedule
Rituximab 375 d1; cyclophosphamide 300 q12h d1–3 (6 doses); doxorubicin 25 CIV d1+2; vincristine 2 mg d3; dexamethasone 40 mg d1–4
Rituximab 375 d1; cisplatin 100 CIV d1; cytarabine 2000 q12h ×2 d2; dexamethasone 40 mg d1–4
Bortezomib 1.3 SQ d2, 5, 9, 12; rituximab 375 + cyclophosphamide 1000 d1; prednisone 100 mg d2–6
Ibrutinib 560 mg daily · acalabrutinib 100 mg BID · zanubrutinib 160 mg BID (or 320 mg daily) — continuous until progression
blocks.footnote: mg/m² unless stated. Cytarabine → 1 g/m² if age >60, with prednisolone 1% eye drops. R-GemOx needs ANC ≥1,000 and platelets ≥100,000 to proceed. Consider aspirin with lenalidomide.

blocks.heading: Pearls
items: Follicular grade IIIb is not an indolent lymphoma — centrocytes are absent and it is treated as DLBCL
Maintenance rituximab buys time to next treatment, not survival — worth saying out loud when consenting
Mantle cell TP53 mutation changes the plan, not just the prognosis — chemotherapy, transplant and ibrutinib all underperform; go to trial or a targeted combination
† The handbook covers no mantle cell biology — cyclin D1, t(11;14), SOX11, Ki-67 and the blastoid variant are absent, as is the indolent leukemic-non-nodal subset that can be observed

blocks.heading: Trials
rows: Maintenance rituximab ×2 yr after frontline immunochemotherapy in follicular
BR vs R-CHOP — the basis for BR frontline
Obinutuzumab vs rituximab with chemotherapy in follicular
R² vs R-chemo — negative superiority trial; R² is equivalent
Ibrutinib in induction + maintenance — no benefit from auto-HCT (endpoint: FFS)
No auto-HCT benefit in MRD-negative complete remission
BTK inhibitor added to chemoimmunotherapy in older MCL

text: Indolent and mantle B-cell lymphoma Follicular and mantle cell — grouped because both are managed as chronic disease with BTK inhibitors, bendamustine and maintenance, not because mantle cell is indolent. It is not : it is biologically aggressive and behaves like a disease you manage rather than cure Stanford Oncology Handbook 2025, Lymphoma: Non-Hodgkin, pp.223–232 · NCCN B-Cell Lymphoma v2.2025 · items marked † are outside the handbook chapter Follicular grade Grade Incidence Histology and behavior I 40–45% 0–5 centroblasts/hpf — indolent, “classic FL” (WHO 2022) II 30% 6–15 centroblasts/hpf — indolent, classic FL IIIa 20% >15 centroblasts/hpf, centrocytes present — indolent or aggressive IIIb — >15 centroblasts/hpf, centrocytes absent , sheets of centroblasts — aggressive, behaves like DLBCL FLIPI — “NoLASH”, 1 point each Risk % 5-yr OS 10-yr OS Low (0–1) 36 91% 71% Intermediate (2) 37 78% 51% High (3–5) 27 53% 36% No dal sites >4 · L DH elevated · A ge ≥60 · S tage III–IV · H gb <12. FLIPI2 instead uses age >60, β2-microglobulin > ULN, marrow involvement, Hgb <12 and largest node >6 cm — 5-yr PFS 80% / 51% / 19% . GELF — when to treat follicular • ≥3 nodal areas each ≥3 cm • Any nodal or extranodal mass ≥7 cm • Symptoms attributable to disease, including B symptoms or effusions/ascites • Cytopenias from lymphoma (WBC <1,000 and/or platelets <100,000) • Leukemic phase >5,000 cells/µL • Splenomegaly Meeting none of these is a reason to observe , not to treat. Brice, JCO 1997 · NCCN v2.2025. MIPI — mantle cell Points Age ECOG LDH / ULN WBC K/uL 0 <50 0–1 <0.67 <6.7 1 50–59 — 0.67–0.99 6.7–9.99 2 60–69 2–4 1.00–1.49 10–14.99 3 ≥70 — ≥1.50 ≥15 Hoster, Blood 2008. The handbook prints the points table but not the risk-group cutoffs or their survival . TP53 in mantle cell. Mutated in ~10% and a strong predictor of poor outcome with chemotherapy and with autologous transplant, and also with ibrutinib. Send NGS at diagnosis ; prefer a clinical trial. Deep responses have been seen with targeted combinations — BOVen (zanubrutinib/obinutuzumab/venetoclax) and OAsIs. The old PFS benefit predates BTKi and maintenance. TRIANGLE found no benefit once ibrutinib was added, and EA4151 none for patients in MRD-negative CR .
